Neftegaz, July 2022, on survey work for line 3. Says each of lines 1 and 2 is 1.2 thousand km, the two together have 115 bcm a year of design capacity, and line 3 has a design capacity of about 69 bcm a year.
Sever-Press, October 2018. Says line 3 of Bovanenkovo-Ukhta has a design capacity of 69.2 bcm a year and is to be built by 2023.
Gazprom Proektirovanie explanatory note for line 3, third stage. States 1,420 mm pipe at 11.8 MPa, a system length of about 1,153.8 km for line 3 and a planned commissioning date of 31 December 2024.

Gazprom investor page on Bovanenkovo-Ukhta, Wayback copy of October 2023. About lines 1 and 2: about 1,200 km each, 1,420 mm pipe, 115 bcm a year for both, line 1 in service 2012. It does not cover line 3.

Neftegaz, Nord Stream 2 resource base story. Says lines 1 and 2 are 1,200 km each and the cost is up to 1,000 billion rubles, about 40 billion US dollars. The cost is stated for the system of two lines, not for each line.
Gazstroyprom projects page. Lists other Gazprom projects such as Kovykta and Chayanda and gives no values for the Bovanenkovo-Ukhta lines.

Gazprom website page on Bovanenkovo-Ukhta and Bovanenkovo-Ukhta 2, Wayback copy of December 2021. About lines 1 and 2 only: 1,420 mm pipe, 115 bcm a year for both, line 1 in service 2012, line 2 in service 2017. It does not cover line 3.
Russian government document listing planned gas projects. It names the third line by districts of Komi and Yamal and gives no length or capacity.

Interview with the head of Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta in a Gazprom magazine, April 2019. Says line 1 is fully in service with a 1,106 km linear part and that line 2 had a 1,108.1 km linear part put into service in 2017.
Russian government territorial planning scheme, appendix, Wayback copy of July 2024. Lists planned pipelines and gives no value for these lines.
Neftegaz, November 2024, read as a Wayback copy. About 13 Gazprom pipelines assigned for construction and rebuilding. It does not name the Bovanenkovo-Ukhta lines.
Tender notice for a geographic information system for the Bovanenkovo-Ukhta line 3 construction project. It shows design work for line 3 and gives no values.
Komi investment news page. Says a plant's products may be used for building line 3 of Bovanenkovo-Ukhta and mentions work in 2024 to 2028 with Gazprom. No length or capacity.
Gazstroyprom tender list of March 2023. Mentions line 3 of Bovanenkovo-Ukhta only as the reason for a purchase. No values.
Gazprom investor reports page for 2020, a list of links. States no values for these lines.
Open Infra Map web map. The page is a map shell with no readable text about these lines.

Ukhta city planning page listing approvals for the line 3 project. It shows planning approvals in 2020 and 2021 and gives no values.
